name: predge-whale-data
description: Outcome-verified prediction-market whale intelligence + signed settled sports outcomes, pay-per-call over x402.
long_description: 17 tools (1 free discovery + 16 paid). Wallets ranked by outcome-verified win rate on RESOLVED markets (edge over market price x capital), smart-money consensus from proven winners, and TWO flagship signed attestations: /v1/attest returns each settled Polymarket outcome, and /v1/sports/attest returns each finished game's result (winner + final score) - both as cryptographically signed ed25519 receipts, verifiable offline against Predge's published key. Use them to settle bets, prove a track record, or ground a wager on tamper-evident truth. Pay-per-call over x402 (USDC on Base or Solana) - no accounts, no signup. You bring your OWN funded key (Base and/or Solana); it stays on this machine and never leaves.

buyer_private_key.title: Buyer private key
buyer_private_key.description: A funded Base-mainnet EVM private key (0x...) used to sign USDC micropayments per paid call. Stays on your machine. Leave empty to use only the free discovery tool.

max_price_usd.title: Max price per call (USD)
max_price_usd.description: Refuse any call priced above this (USD) before money moves.

solana_buyer_secret.title: Solana buyer secret
solana_buyer_secret.description: Optional. A funded Solana-mainnet key (64-number JSON array or base58) to ALSO pay on Solana. Stays on your machine. Either this or the Base key enables paid tools.
